body:
Investigated live server.log for the current boot: tick loop steady, save_player permission fix (S206-72) holding, exactly one 60s no-packet timeout this boot matching the founder's report window. Ruled out idle-input-causes-timeout theory by reading apps/client/src/main.c directly -- client sends UserCmd every frame regardless of movement. Honest conclusion: no code bug found, real gap is missing diagnostics -- named as S206-95 (surface gap-duration number on the weak-connection overlay).

⚓ ☃
title: Reconnection message follow-up — real findings, no code bug found
